description: This file defines a BufferMemory node class for managing chat message memory, including initialization and retrieval of chat messages from a database, within a larger AI or chat application.

classes.name: BufferMemory_Memory
classes.description: A node class implementing chat memory retrieval, with configuration for session and memory key.

classes.name: BufferMemoryExtended
classes.description: An extension of FlowiseMemory that manages chat message retrieval and formatting from a database.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes BufferMemoryExtended with parameters from nodeData and options, returning a new memory instance.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from the database, optionally prepending messages and converting to base message format.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for adding chat messages, handled on server level.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for clearing chat messages, handled on server level.
